With the launch of the historic Artemis II mission, the crew will travel around the moon and back on a 10-day journey in the Orion crew capsule, a tiny space of just 330 cubic feet—about the size of two minivans. Ahead of the launch, NASA astronauts gave us a tour of a replica of their new home—and cramped sleeping quarters.Take an inside look at the Orion spacecraft at the link in bio.
